title: Research diagramming prior art and choose the diagram notation
description: Phase 1: survey prior-art diagramming skills/prompts for agent harnesses, SDLC diagramming practice (C4, arc42, UML subset, BPMN-lite, ADR/decision, dependency and roadmap views), diagrams-as-code tools (Mermaid, PlantUML, D2, Structurizr, Graphviz) and standards (size, labelling, accessibility, diffability). Record findings in lore and decide the notation in an ADR.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A lore research doc cites sources for prior art, SDLC diagram types, the diagrams-as-code comparison and the standards
A lore ADR states two notation options, recommendation first, with the trade-off for each
The notation decision is answered by the user and recorded in the ADR

plan: 1. Parallel research: prior art + SDLC practice + standards; diagrams-as-code comparison with local parse tests
2. Author lore Reference doc with citations
3. Author lore ADR with two notation options, recommendation first
4. Ask the user; record the answer in the ADR
implementationNotes: Research doc and ADR-0001 drafted; decision DEC record created as proposed. Mermaid parse check (mermaid@11.17.2 + jsdom) proven 28/28 pass, 12/12 fail in scratch lab.
Owner chose Option A (Mermaid) on 2026-10-05; ADR-0001 Accepted, DEC-1 accepted.
lore check exit 0 after ADR acceptance (3 files, 0 errors).
finalSummary: Research doc docs/reference/state-of-the-art-in-diagramming-for-agent-written-docs.md (69 sources, local notation lab evidence) and ADR-0001 accepted: Mermaid in Markdown, conservative profile, headless parse gate pinned to GitHub's Mermaid 11.17.2 (DEC-1).
